01.name: window_sill
01.prompt:
Image 1 is the STYLE reference (copy its art style only, not its content). Image 2 is the LAYOUT reference: the SAME cozy apartment (same window, curtains, plant, rug, shelf, colours) seen from a new spot. Image 3 is the CHARACTER SHEET of Naomi: copy her exact face, markings, colours and art style wherever she appears.

Beautiful Japanese anime illustration in the polished style of a high-quality gacha game / visual novel: delicate clean linework, soft cel shading with smooth gradients, luminous pastel colours, gentle glow and bloom, sparkling highlights, rich fine details, cozy healing (iyashikei) mood. Match the art style of the style reference image exactly.

First-person view through the eyes of the cat Naomi: the camera is LOW, about 25 cm above the surface she stands on, slightly wide-angle, as if the viewer IS the cat. At most her own two fluffy WHITE mitten front paws show at the bottom edge. Wide 16:9 game scene. Keep the lower 20 % calm (subtitles go there). No text, no logo, no watermark, no UI.

Naomi sits on the wide wooden WINDOWSILL on a WINTER morning. LEFT half: the big window glass very close to her, with delicate white frost flowers on the lower corners of the pane; outside a pale blue sky and snowy rooftops. Bright golden winter sunlight streams in through the glass from the upper left, a warm sunbeam falls across the sill and her white paws. On the glass, a soft, faint, semi-transparent REFLECTION of Naomi's own face (blue-grey and white, white inverted-V blaze, pink nose, big olive-green eyes) looking back at the viewer. RIGHT half: the cozy living room seen from the sill height, slightly blurred (round cream rug, low shelf, little cat tower), empty. Cold blue glass on the left, warm gold light on the right: a clear cool-and-warm contrast.

Naomi, a real domestic CAT (an animal on four legs, not a human, not a cat girl, no clothes): a very fluffy long-haired blue-grey and white bicolour cat (Siberian / Ragamuffin type). Soft blue-grey fur on the top of the head, the ears, the back, the sides and the tail, with faint darker grey tabby shading on the flanks; a pure WHITE inverted-V blaze from the forehead down between the eyes to the muzzle; white muzzle and chin; a huge fluffy white chest ruff and white belly; white mitten paws on all four feet; a small soft PINK nose; big round OLIVE-GREEN / yellow-green eyes; grey ears with long white tufts inside; long white whiskers; a very long plush darker-grey tail. Round, chubby, extremely soft and fluffy. Cute anime proportions: slightly big round head, big shiny eyes with sparkly highlights, soft pink blush on the cheeks. Personality: gentle, obedient, a little shy and easy to tease — a sweet, soft, good-natured cat.

Avoid: ukiyo-e, woodblock print, gold leaf, realistic photo, photorealistic fur, 3D render, CGI, horror, gritty, dark muddy colours, text, letters, writing, logo, watermark, signature, frame, border, blurry, low resolution, jpeg artifacts, deformed, extra limbs, extra tails, extra ears, cat girl, clothes, collar, phone stickers, hearts, showing the owner's face, extra paws, full cat body in front of the camera.
